community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Message other captains or platform support (it is often the first entry in the list). You must be a captain with a linked team, except for read-only admin use.
community.writeRequiresContact: To write, pick a contact (do not leave “All”) or use Reply on a message in this list.
community.noTeamsInDirectory: No other teams are in the directory right now.
community.noMyTeam: You have no team. Join or create one under Team.
community.loadFailed: Could not load the directory or the conversation.
community.noMessages: No messages yet. Write the first one below.
community.deleteConfirm: Delete this message? It may be removed for your team; the other team might still have history on the server.
community.unavailable: Community messaging is not on the server yet. When it is deployed, this screen will work automatically.
community.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

home.title: E-DragonBoat
home.lead: Platform for dragon boat teams: record free training from the mobile app, review it in this panel with charts, GPS maps and export, and manage your crew.
home.featTraining: Training: sessions uploaded from the app, filtered by your team; detail with summary, tables, charts (distance, speed, SPM, DPS, strokes) and course map.
home.featMaps: Maps and JPG: course on map (or satellite); you can download an image with the map and a summary (date, team, boat, paddlers, distance in m).
home.featTeam: Team: club data and roles (captain, coach, paddler). The captain can edit the team name and country, delete it and invite by email. The coach sees the same in training and crew, and can change roles and remove members, but cannot invite or edit team data.
home.featAccount: Account: your profile, password and language. The crew is under Team.
home.featCompetitions: Races: runs uploaded from the app when you tap Done; same detail as training (charts, map).

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Same user as in the mobile app and the API.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitleHtml: Sign up with email and password (no email verification). You can then create your team in Team.
register.footerHtml: Already have an account? Log in
register.errorPasswordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

account.title: Account
account.roleAndTeamReadOnly: This is managed under Team, not here.
account.noMembershipLine: You are not a member of a team yet.
account.pwdMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account.noTeamHtml: You have no team. You can create one in Team.

sessionDetail.title: Session {id}
sessionDetail.paddlerNoteHtml: As a paddler you only see the summary and the map.
sessionDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete this training session? This cannot be undone.
sessionDetail.headingSamples: Per-second samples (all keys in each point)
sessionDetail.chartForceHint: Peaks per second (bar only if there was a reading that second).
sessionDetail.mapIntro: Boat track with GPS points from the app (one position per second, when signal is available).
sessionDetail.mapDownloadHint: Download the map with the training summary (JPG).
sessionDetail.mapNoGps: No GPS coordinates in this session (older recording or no signal).
sessionDetail.exploreHint: Lower axis: time (seconds). Upper axis: distance in metres (when distanceMeters is present). You can overlay up to three Y series.

sessions.title: Open training
sessions.filterHint: Only sessions whose teamName in the app matches this team’s name (case-insensitive) are listed.
sessions.noTeamHintHtml: You have no team: all your sessions are shown. Create one from the Team menu to filter by name.
sessions.emptyHintWithTeamHtml: In the app, the session must use the same team name as {teamName}.
sessions.emptyHintNoTeam: Save a session from the app with this account.
sessions.dayMapAria: Combined map for the selected day
sessions.dayMapHint: Download the map with the day summary (JPG).
sessions.mapNoGpsDay: No GPS coordinates in the sessions for that day.
sessions.jpgExportError: Could not generate the JPG (sometimes because map tiles are still loading). Wait for the map to load and try again, or use a screenshot.

errors.notFoundDeploy: Resource not found (404). Upload the updated app/main.py (routes /api/v1/profile and DELETE /api/v1/equipo/{id}) or the full project, then restart: sudo systemctl restart edragonboat-api.

teams.emptyNoTeam: You are not a member of any team yet.
teams.adminAllHint: Select the team to view and edit the roster below. Club settings (name, country, delete) are still under Settings.
teams.plantelHint: Roster data is saved on the server. Captain and coach can edit rows; captain and admin can change emails. Use Save roster to apply all changes.
teams.inviteHintHtml: You can invite by email even without an account: a user is created with password 12345678 (they should change it in Account). If the server has SMTP, they receive the login email.
teams.inviteCoachOnlyHtml: Only the captain can invite new people to the team.
teams.inviteSuccessMember: Done: they are on the team.
teams.inviteSuccessNewWithEmail: New account created and email sent with the temporary password.
teams.inviteSuccessNewNoSmtp: New account created (password 12345678). No email was sent: configure SMTP on the server.
teams.logoHint: Recommended: square 512×512 px, PNG (white or transparent background) or JPEG. It is normalized to PNG up to 512 px on a side.
teams.deleteHint: Removes the team and memberships. Uploaded training sessions are not deleted.
teams.onlyCaptainEdits: Only the captain can change the name, country, or delete the team.
teams.pickPngJpeg: Choose a PNG or JPEG file.
teams.confirmDeleteTeam: Delete this team permanently? This cannot be undone.
teams.confirmRemoveMember: Remove this person from the team?

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.emptyLead: Races recorded in the app when the distance is finished and Complete is tapped (requires API with POST /api/v1/sessions/competencia).
competitions.introGlobalHtml: Global list: competitions from all teams are shown (login required). You can open the detail only for your team’s sessions (or ones you uploaded).
competitions.emptyWhenUploaded: When someone finishes a race and uploads the session from the app, it will appear here.
competitions.mainHint: Sessions uploaded when the race ends in the app. Open one for charts, table and map (same as Training).
competitions.idLockedTitle: You can only open your team’s detail

routines.noTeams: You have no teams. Create one under Team.
routines.noTeamsShort: You have no teams. Team
routines.title: Routines
routines.toolbarHint: Pick a team and manage training routines (exercises by time, distance, or strokes).
routines.emptyTable: No routines. Create one with New routine.
routines.newHint: Name first; then you can add exercises one by one.
routines.editorHint: Add one at a time: type, unit and value. Reorder with ↑ ↓.
